dedupe_keys.name: vienna 5g simulators system level and link level

description: The Vienna 5G Simulators are the newest members of the Vienna Cellular Communications Simulators, a suite of MATLAB link-level and system-level simulators for fourth and fifth generation mobile networks developed at the Institute of Telecommunications of TU Wien. The Vienna 5G System Level Simulator models multi-node cellular networks with base stations, users, mobility, path loss, shadowing and small-scale fading, schedulers and interference, and estimates throughput and signal quality over large layouts; the Link Level Simulator models the physical layer of 5G New Radio waveforms, coding and MIMO. Release 1.4 of the system-level simulator has been available since October 2023, with a user manual and an online forum for support. Coverage: user-defined deployments of any size, including city layouts built from building data; no real network data is shipped. Format and access: MATLAB code (2020b or newer; the Communications Toolbox and QuaDRiGa channel code are optional) downloaded after accepting the licence agreement; free of charge under an academic use licence, and commercial use needs a separate agreement. Caveats: needs a MATLAB licence; the academic licence restricts use; releases are infrequent. Simulation uses: capacity planning of 5G networks, coverage and hazard exposure under site failures, and research on resilient and sustainable radio access networks for digital twins. Related records: Simu5G and ns-3 are open alternatives, Sionna covers link level and ray tracing, and OpenCelliD can give realistic site layouts.
